description: Source code for neighbor table management in Zephyr networking stack, handling neighbor cache, reference counting, linking/unlinking neighbors, and printing neighbor info.

methods.name: net_nbr_unref
methods.description: Decrements reference count of neighbor, calls remove callback if count reaches zero.

methods.name: net_nbr_get
methods.description: Retrieves a free neighbor entry from the neighbor table.

methods.name: net_nbr_link
methods.description: Links a neighbor to an interface with a given link-layer address.

methods.name: net_nbr_unlink
methods.description: Unlinks a neighbor from its link-layer address.

methods.name: net_nbr_lookup
methods.description: Finds a neighbor in the table matching interface and link-layer address.

methods.name: net_nbr_get_lladdr
methods.description: Returns the link-layer address storage for a neighbor index.

methods.name: net_nbr_clear_table
methods.description: Clears all neighbor entries in the table.

methods.name: net_nbr_print
methods.description: Prints neighbor table entries for debugging.
